text: Age: 44
Occupation: Council Member/Financial Crimes Investigator

My name is Joshua Barron. I am a lifelong South Gate resident and attended Stanford Elementary, South Gate Middle School, South Gate High School, ELAC, and Cerritos College. My wife Elizabeth and I have raised our three daughters in the community we call home.
I serve as Mayor and have completed four years on the South Gate City Council, including three years as City Auditor. I continue working as a Financial Crimes Investigator for a bank in Los Angeles.

On the City Council, I have addressed residents' concerns, worked to protect essential services, developed responsible solutions to our fiscal challenges, and advocated for property tax reform. I created programs promoting local businesses and worked on regional mobility and transit solutions. I advocated for resources that helped bring Urban Orchard, Hollydale Community Park, and Circle Park to our city and championed youth sports.

As Charter President of SELA Kiwanis, I supported youth leadership, awarded college scholarships, organized food assistance during the Palisades fires and immigration enforcement actions, and led neighborhood cleanups.
In another term, I will strengthen public safety, improve infrastructure, restore financial stability, support local businesses, and expand opportunities for our youth and families.
I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: Occupation: Councilmember/Retired Educator

For over 26 years, I have proudly served the City of South Gate as an educator, community leader, and Councilmember. My commitment has always been to improving public safety and upgrading city infrastructure, including sidewalks, streets, lighting, and water systems. I remain dedicated to expanding educational opportunities, supporting working families, and enhancing the quality of life in our neighborhoods.

As a longtime advocate for higher education, I have led efforts to increase access to college and career opportunities. Next year, we will open a newly constructed college campus in South Gate that will provide academic, workforce training, career pathways, and employment opportunities for current and future generations to come.
As a member of the HUB Cities Board, I led efforts to bring the HUB Cities WorkSource Center to South Gate on Tweedy Boulevard, connecting residents with job training and employment opportunities.
I have also advocated for safer, cleaner parks, improved city services, environmental justice, and additional funding to support elders, youth, and families.
As your Councilmember, I will continue working to strengthen public safety, improve city services, and ensure South Gate remains a safe, thriving, and family-centered community.
I respectfully ask for your support and your vote.

text: Age: 47
Occupation: Real Estate Broker

Edgar Pelayo, a lifelong resident and proud product of South Gate, is running for South Gate City Council to bring transparent leadership, accountability, and practical economic insight to City Hall. Local government works best when residents have a seat at the table, and I am committed to fostering an open, inclusive environment where community voices drive city decisions.

As a Real Estate Broker with over 20 years of experience and a dedicated community advocate, I balance my career with active leadership as vice president of a local nonprofit supporting youth and families. The skills I've built throughout my career such as strategic negotiation, budget management, and collaborative problem-solving, will be instrumental in representing our community effectively.
Through my nonprofit work and my service as a South Gate Parks and Recreation Commissioner, I've seen firsthand how powerful our community is when we come together.

I am running for City Council to ensure our local government operates with transparency, efficiency, and true representation. I am ready to stand up for our neighborhoods and families, and guide South Gate toward a brighter future. I would be honored to earn your trust and your vote.
Let's Move South Gate Forward, Together

text: Age: 46
Occupation: Nonprofit Executive
38-Year South Gate Resident
Education: Bachelor's and Master's degrees, San Francisco State University
Jimmy Ozaeta is the son of immigrant parents from Durango, Mexico. Born and raised in South Gate, he attended Stanford Elementary, South Gate Middle School, and South Gate High School, Class of 1998.
Jimmy Ozaeta sees a City Hall facing governance gaps, fiscal mismanagement, and fractured community trust. He doesn't see problems beyond repair; he sees a role he's spent 25 years preparing to fill.

Jimmy Ozaeta has built his career turning crisis into stability. He has dedicated more than 25 years to the nonprofit sector, serving in senior executive leadership roles, including Chief Executive Officer of a YMCA Association, while serving on state, regional, and national cabinets.
Jimmy Ozaeta's service isn't a talking point; it's the thread running through every chapter of his life.

Jimmy Ozaeta is running for City Council because the city that shaped him deserves a City Hall rooted in honesty, transparency, and the same unconditional commitment he has always given the community.

Vote For Jimmy Ozaeta!
